unsupported: Foliot Furniture was founded in 1991 in Montreal, Quebec, by Daniel Foliot, a former aspiring lawyer who sold his stake in a woodworking company to start his own venture.

Known for: Vertically integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing in-house; Three North American manufacturing facilities (Las Vegas, Montreal, Canadian laminate plant); Over 1.25 million rooms delivered across North America; Industry-leading warranties and lifecycle support programs; 17 collaborative robots deployed to enhance manufacturing precision and safety
